* The [[European Commission]] approves the use of [[mobile phone]]s on European flights.  [https://web.archive.org/web/20080411223845/http://www.gaulia.com/public/website/blog/index.php?post=s1207639290 (Gaulia.com)]
* The [[2007–08 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas Jayhawks]] defeat the [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis Tigers]] in [[Overtime (sports)|overtime]], [[2008 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Game|75-68]], to win the [[2008 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2008 U.S. Division I men's college basketball championship]]. [https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=284000063 (ESPN)]
* The ''[[The Washington Post|Washington Post]]'' wins six [[2008 Pulitzer Prize|Pulitzer Prize]]s including the [[Pulitzer Prize for Public Service]] for a series of articles of [[Walter Reed Army Medical Center neglect scandal|poor conditions for veterans]] at the [[Walter Reed Army Medical Center]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/content/story/2008/04/07/ST2008040701372.html (''The Washington Post'')]
* [[2008 Summer Olympics]]
** The [[Olympic torch]] is extinguished by officials as police are confronted by protesters during the [[2008 Summer Olympics torch relay|Olympic torch relay]] through [[Paris]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/7334545.stm (BBC News)]
** [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] ([[Democratic Party (United States)|D]]-[[New York (state)|NY]]) [[Hillary Clinton]] calls on [[President of the United States|President]] [[George W. Bush]] to boycott the opening ceremony at the [[Summer Olympics]] in [[Beijing]]. [http://blogs.abcnews.com/politicalradar/2008/04/clinton-calls-o.html (ABC News)]
** The [[President of the International Olympic Committee|head]] of the [[International Olympic Committee]] [[Jacques Rogge]] says he's "very concerned" about [[2008 Tibetan unrest|unrest]] in [[Tibet]] and [[Concerns and controversies at the 2008 Summer Olympics|other issues]] associated with the Summer Olympics. [https://www.france24.com/en/20080407-ioc-chief-rogge-concerned-about-tibet-beijing-2008-olympics (France 24)]
** The Beijing Organizing Committee for the Games of the [[2008 Summer Olympics|Summer Olympiad]] claims that the "Olympic torch has received a warm welcome worldwide." [https://web.archive.org/web/20080410092524/http://torchrelay.beijing2008.cn/en/news/headlines/n214296388.shtml?loc=interstitialskip (Beijing 2008)]
* [[China–New Zealand relations|China and New Zealand]] sign a [[New Zealand–China Free Trade Agreement|free trade agreement]]. This is China's first trade agreement with a developed nation. [https://www.nytimes.com/2008/04/07/business/worldbusiness/07iht-7tradefw.11718461.html (''The New York Times'')]
